notes: Review candidate built directly on the verified v3.4.27 stable Source Documents manager and library. Adds only an isolated related-record decorator: it flags same-title/same-destination record groups, adds a related-record count in the library, and reports when no duplicate groups are detected. It does not replace manager rendering, mutate records, merge records, delete records, or change verification/storage logic. Also makes the ChatGPT build-label observer idempotent to avoid unnecessary DOM rewrites.
